type: opcode class type 123 (misnamed tfbPhysicsModel), text "clone||at|facing||cloned"; compact form 0x40 {7B, rc, name, 0,0,0, flags, 0, ->own+0x30 sub-object (type 0x7C), 0, ->B (type 114 record), ->C (type 102 record), 7C 1 1 1}; extended form 0x214 with an inline position at +0x94
structure: The engine`s own entity-spawn instruction, and what the M2-confirmed spawn record really is

location.offset: 592 instances; 138 local to their script; extended form: InitializeLevel.ai instruction #2 at 0x1A76EC (+0x94 = (91.731, 10.31, 44.741))

meaning: The CONFIRMED spawn record (level.physicsmodel.spawn-candidate) is instruction #2 of the level-init script InitializeLevel.ai: a "clone ... at ... facing" that clones the player character at the start position, which is why moving its +0x94 argument moved the Skylander (M2). The 137 compact clones (lanterns, bridges, chompy spawners, cannon balls, cracked-wall parts ...) carry no inline position: their asset/position/facing come from referenced type-114/102 expression records (shared, e.g. 0x188CBC / 0x187BA8, or local like 0x25D9C8 in Chompie_Spawner_Arena.ai). Consequences for a VISIBLE duplication: (a) duplicating a compact clone instruction spawns a second entity at the SAME computed position (overlapping); (b) a visible offset needs an instruction whose position is inline (the extended form) or a modified position expression; (c) any duplicate must be a same-size replacement of a sacrificable record inside the same script (the owner`s pointer array already addresses that slot), never an insertion.

evidence.probe: scratch clones.mjs / clonerefs.mjs over the script decoder
evidence.summary: 138 local clone instructions, all type 123; compact refs -> own+0x30, type-114 and type-102 records; InitializeLevel #2 is the 0x214 form with the spawn triple inline
moving +0x94 of that instruction displaced the Skylander spawn in 2/2 runs (M2 PASS)
